text: User-reported first six-DOF oracle result: rotation error 0.13686348485276628 deg versus the 0.05 deg gate. The gate was not weakened. Review showed the 1 mm analytic grid undersampled 1.3 mm Gaussian structure, shifting the trilinear discrete optimum, and the fixture mislabeled a z-only rotation as six-DOF. Revised fixture uses a 0.5 mm 41^3 grid and the independent transform Rz(4 deg) * Ry(-3 deg) * Rx(2 deg) plus nonzero x/y/z translation. Focused rerun required.
